caption: The drawing features two red flowers with yellow centers and green stems, leaves, and sepals. The flowers are positioned on either side of a single green stem that curves upward and branches toward both flowers. The stem includes several jagged-edged green leaves. The composition is enclosed within a diamond shape filled with a pattern of closely spaced, curved gray lines on a light background, while the rest of the background is plain and beige. The corners of the paper are slightly worn and discolored, and there is a small printed or written text, "Alois L. Ulrich," in the lower right section outside the diamond-shaped area.
title: Quilt Pattern
